description: This Java class handles the update process for guarantors in a loan account within the Fineract project. It is an implementation of a command handler that processes update commands for guarantors by invoking a service layer.

classes.name: UpdateGuarantorCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class annotated as a Spring @Service that handles 'UPDATE' commands for guarantors, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, and delegating the update operation to GuarantorWritePlatformService.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming JsonCommand to update guarantor information via the writePlatformService.
